categories.main_business_segments: AIRMAN CORPORATION operates two main business segments: the Construction Machinery segment, which includes engine compressors, engine generators, and aerial work platforms; and the Industrial Machinery segment, which includes motor compressors and emergency generators. Both segments involve manufacturing and sales activities, with a focus on construction and industrial machinery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced air compression and power generation technologies, including high-efficiency air ends, inverter-controlled motor compressors, and compliance with global emission regulations. It is actively developing sustainable products such as hydrogen-fueled compressors and generators, biofuel-compatible generators, and fuel cell power units. Production emphasizes quality management (ISO9001/14001), automation, and energy-efficient manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, rental equipment firms (notably large North American rental companies), industrial facilities, and infrastructure developers. The main end markets are construction, civil engineering, industrial plants, and public infrastructure, with a significant portion of sales to rental companies and direct industrial users.
categories.geographic_coverage: AIRMAN has a strong domestic presence in Japan and a significant international footprint, particularly in North America, Asia (including Southeast Asia and China), and Europe. The company operates subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Malaysia, and China, with overseas sales accounting for over 44% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned as a midstream and downstream manufacturer, producing finished construction and industrial machinery for end users and rental companies. It sources raw materials and components from both domestic and international suppliers and manages assembly, quality control, and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding in North America, strengthening direct sales in domestic industrial markets, and developing environmentally friendly products. R&D focuses on decarbonization (hydrogen, biofuel, and fuel cell technologies), high-efficiency compressors, compliance with global emission standards, and digital transformation (DX) for productivity. The company is also investing in human capital and diversity to support global growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of manufactured products (compressors, generators, aerial work platforms), parts, and after-sales services. The company also benefits from direct sales, rental company partnerships, and maintenance contracts, with revenue recognized upon delivery or completion of service.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AIRMAN holds a leading position in the Japanese engine compressor market and is expanding its share in motor compressors domestically. Major competitors include global construction and industrial machinery manufacturers such as Atlas Copco, Sullair, and domestic rivals like Hitachi and Kobelco. The company differentiates itself through product quality, environmental innovation, and strong relationships with rental companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated sales reached approximately 54.8 billion yen, with operating profit at 6.9 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders at 4.8 billion yen. The company has shown steady growth in sales and profits over recent years, with a robust balance sheet, high equity ratio (63.7%), and a workforce of over 800 employees. The medium-term plan targets further revenue and profit growth, especially overseas.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AIRMAN emphasizes high product reliability, compliance with stringent global emission standards, and advanced energy-saving technologies. Its value proposition centers on providing high-quality, environmentally responsible machinery that meets diverse customer needs, supported by strong after-sales service and a commitment to sustainability and innovation.
